description: This file defines the ScorecardValue class used to encapsulate data related to a scorecard entry, including question ID, response ID, value, and creation timestamp. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and a static factory method.

classes.name: ScorecardValue
classes.description: A data holder object representing a scorecard entry with question ID, response ID, score value, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ScorecardValue with specified details.

methods.name: getQuestionId
methods.description: Returns the question ID associated with this scorecard entry.

methods.name: setQuestionId
methods.description: Sets the question ID for this scorecard entry.

methods.name: getResponseId
methods.description: Returns the response ID associated with this scorecard entry.

methods.name: setResponseId
methods.description: Sets the response ID for this scorecard entry.
